options.concept: Small-club soundcheck: lead guitarist plucks one chord while listening toward the drummer, who holds a counted pause; a bassist watches their cue.
Rehearsal after the stage power returns: lead guitarist and bassist resume one unison chord, and drummer catches their pickup.
Intimate afternoon stage rehearsal: a lead guitarist visibly counts the band into a first soft downbeat, bassist and drummer poised to join.
